description: NEW IN THIS REVIEW. Portuguese as a donor for requesters OUTSIDE its own language, which the pt-pair fixture cannot provide because both of its Portuguese donors serve Portuguese requesters. Loaded: pt (donor), en, ru, ar. French is deliberately NOT loaded here: verified against GeneratedCldrPluralData, fr and pt have equivalent cardinal rule sets ('i = 0,1' versus 'i = 0..1' are the same predicate, and their many-rules are the identical string), so no count could discriminate an fr requester from a pt donor and such a case would be pure decoration. Four loaded locales, four distinct primary language codes, so tiebreakers are null.
